title: Ex-Rockstar Boss Dan Houser Won't Play GTA 6 for Creative Reasons
description: Former Rockstar co-boss and GTA creative director Dan Houser reveals he doesn't play open-world games and won't play GTA 6, explaining the creative reasons behind this decision as he works on new projects at Absurd Ventures.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## A Surprising Stance from a Legendary Creator

For millions of gamers eagerly anticipating the release of *GTA 6*, a recent revelation from a key industry figure might come as a surprise. Dan Houser, the former co-boss of Rockstar Games and the former creative director behind the *Grand Theft Auto* series, has shared that he does not play a lot of open-world games. More specifically, he does not plan on playing *GTA 6* either.

As one of the chief architects who helped shape the modern open-world gaming landscape, Houser's decision to bypass the industry's biggest upcoming title raises eyebrows. However, rather than signaling any indifference to the medium, his choice stems from a very deliberate and focused creative philosophy at his new venture.

## Protecting Creative Originality at Absurd Ventures

According to reports from IGN Games, Houser's refusal to dive into open-world titles and *GTA 6* is driven by a solid creative reason: **he does not want to be influenced by them**. 

Since parting ways with Rockstar Games, Houser has embarked on a fresh entrepreneurial journey, leading his new enterprise, Absurd Ventures. At this new studio, he is actively working on two brand-new game projects. To maintain absolute creative freedom and ensure that his new visions are not unintentionally colored or constrained by existing industry titans—including the very franchise he helped build—he consciously chooses to steer clear of playing them.

Industry analysts note that for a creator of Houser's caliber, preserving an unpolluted mental workspace is crucial when building new intellectual properties from the ground up. Avoiding derivative influences allows him to chart a truly original path for Absurd Ventures.

## Looking Ahead

While fans might be disappointed to know that one of the founding fathers of *GTA* won't be experiencing the streets of Vice City in *GTA 6*, Houser's dedication to his new projects is undeniable. As Absurd Ventures continues to develop its upcoming titles, the gaming community will be watching closely to see what kind of fresh narrative and gameplay experiences emerge from this carefully guarded creative process.

### Editor's Take
Dan Houser's decision not to play *GTA 6* highlights the extreme measures top-tier creators sometimes take to protect their artistic vision. By intentionally isolating himself from contemporary open-world games—including his own past masterpieces—he is safeguarding the pure originality of his new projects at Absurd Ventures. It is a bold, principled approach that ultimately fuels even greater anticipation for his future work.
